lines.text: How's the knee been since last time?
Pretty good. Since last time it only aches after I've been on my feet all day at work.
Let me have a look. Right knee bends to a hundred and thirty degrees.
Um, sorry, a hundred and twenty, I was reading the wrong line.
Sorry, I meant to say, since last time I've been back on the bike three times a week.
That's brilliant for it. Add a fourth ride if the knee is happy the next morning, and keep the step downs going, slow on the way down.
